Suggested action: Cheap channels only (email, web). They buy little and rarely respond, so costly campaigns such as printed catalogues don't pay back.
Discount and deal campaigns. Half their purchases use one, and they accept offers far more often than other low spenders.
Cross-sell and bundles to grow the basket: they already buy often but in mid-sized amounts.
Loyalty perks, premium ranges and early access at full price. They rarely wait for discounts, so discounting them gives margin away.
